#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

int countInsideBraces = 0, longestWord = 0;

int removeUnderscore(std::string str) {
    // Replace all underscores with spaces
    for (auto &ch : str) {
        if (ch == '_') ch = ' ';
    }
    // Trim leading and trailing spaces
    size_t start = str.find_first_not_of(' ');
    size_t end = str.find_last_not_of(' ');
    if (start == std::string::npos || end == std::string::npos) {
        return 0;
    }
    str = str.substr(start, end - start + 1);
    // Replace multiple spaces with a single space
    std::string result;
    bool in_space = false;
    for (char ch : str) {
        if (isspace(ch)) {
            if (!in_space) {
                result += ' ';
                in_space = true;
            }
        } else {
            result += ch;
            in_space = false;
        }
    }
    // Split into tokens
    int count = 0;
    size_t pos = 0;
    while (pos < result.length()) {
        size_t space_pos = result.find(' ', pos);
        if (space_pos == std::string::npos) {
            if (!result.substr(pos).empty()) count++;
            break;
        } else {
            if (!result.substr(pos, space_pos - pos).empty()) count++;
            pos = space_pos + 1;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    std::vector<int> braceIndices;
    braceIndices.push_back(-1);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.length(); i++) {
        if (s[i] == '(' || s[i] == ')') {
            braceIndices.push_back(i);
        }
    }

    int i = 1;
    int count = 0;
    int maxWordLength = 0;
    std::string outsideBraces;

    while (i < (int)braceIndices.size() - 1) {
        int openIdx = braceIndices[i];
        int closeIdx = braceIndices[i + 1];
        std::string inside = s.substr(openIdx + 1, closeIdx - openIdx - 1);
        count = removeUnderscore(inside);
        countInsideBraces += count;
        int prevIdx = braceIndices[i - 1];
        outsideBraces += "_" + s.substr(prevIdx + 1, openIdx - prevIdx - 1);
        i += 2;
    }
    int lastIdx = braceIndices.back();
    outsideBraces += "_" + s.substr(lastIdx + 1);
    // Replace underscores with spaces
    for (auto &ch : outsideBraces) {
        if (ch == '_') ch = ' ';
    }
    // Trim leading and trailing spaces
    size_t start = outsideBraces.find_first_not_of(' ');
    size_t end = outsideBraces.find_last_not_of(' ');
    if (start != std::string::npos && end != std::string::npos) {
        outsideBraces = outsideBraces.substr(start, end - start + 1);
    } else {
        outsideBraces.clear();
    }
    // Replace multiple spaces with a single space
    std::string cleaned;
    bool in_space = false;
    for (char ch : outsideBraces) {
        if (isspace(ch)) {
            if (!in_space) {
                cleaned += ' ';
                in_space = true;
            }
        } else {
            cleaned += ch;
            in_space = false;
        }
    }
    // Split into words
    size_t pos = 0;
    while (pos < cleaned.length()) {
        size_t space_pos = cleaned.find(' ', pos);
        if (space_pos == std::string::npos) {
            if (!cleaned.substr(pos).empty()) {
                if ((int)cleaned.substr(pos).length() > maxWordLength)
                    maxWordLength = cleaned.substr(pos).length();
            }
            break;
        } else {
            if (!cleaned.substr(pos, space_pos - pos).empty()) {
                if ((int)cleaned.substr(pos, space_pos - pos).length() > maxWordLength)
                    maxWordLength = cleaned.substr(pos, space_pos - pos).length();
            }
            pos = space_pos + 1;
        }
    }

    std::cout << maxWordLength << " " << countInsideBraces;
    return 0;
}
